name: backend
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  engine:
    name: Platform-independent engine tests (no SAP needed)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with: { distribution: temurin, java-version: 21 }
      - run: python3 tools/beangen/generate.py --check
      - run: backend/cccore/tools-run.sh
  platform:
    name: SAP Commerce build (needs a licensed platform)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          # SAP Commerce binaries are licensed and not in this repo (docs/assumptions.md AS-09).
          # ChatDaoImpl, ccfacades, ccocc, ccsampledata are NOT compiled by CI until a platform is provided
          # (self-hosted runner or private artifact). Replace this step with the ant build and platform tests.
          echo "::notice::SAP-bound modules are not built in CI yet."

name: contrast
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 -I tools/ci/contrast.py
files..github/workflows/pack-regeneration.yml:
name: pack-regeneration
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Regenerate and require byte-identical output
        run: |
          python3 -I tools/packgen/generate.py
          git diff --exit-code
      - run: python3 -I tools/packgen/test_generate.py
files..github/workflows/secret-scan.yml:
name: secret-scan
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - name: Offline scanner self-test (planted fake key must be caught)
        run: tools/ci/selftest.sh
      - name: gitleaks
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" }
files..github/workflows/storefront.yml:
name: storefront
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 22 }   # ASSUMPTION AS-01
      - run: python3 tools/ci/tokens.py --check
      - working-directory: storefront/chat-feature
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm test
          npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json
          npx ngc -p tsconfig.lib.json
